_comment: Wheel extension, adjacency MEASURED from the PS1 console port (maintainer video, 2026-08-05) and translated BY POSITION: PS1 puts Pyron in vsav's random cell and random at the very bottom; we keep random at 0x0B and put Pyron at the bottom, so those two rows swap. Positions snapped to vsav's own lattice (14z-60o).
_art_note: tile/attr copied from vsav2's own newcomer wheel record (PRG:0x2A6E52, entries 21-23). The tile CODES are placeholders until the art is placed in our gfx; the palette rows (0x13/0x11/0x05) are vs2 rows that vsavj uses for other characters, so colours will be off until the palette work lands. Maintainer: imperfect medallion art is acceptable, mechanical soundness is not.
_coord_note: 14z-62i (maintainer round 2: 'the three medallions don't show at all', both emulators): the record's coordinate pairs are RELATIVE to the wheel drawer object's base, measured (256,176) — back-computed from Jedah's medallion (pair (-20,-119), OBJ (236,57)) and confirmed on Gallon's 3x3 (pair (8,-112), OBJ (264,64)). The cells' 'pos' values are RING-CENTRE coordinates; the sprite-corner offset for a 3x2 medallion is (-12,-7) (Jedah's empirical). The generator converts: pair = pos + corner_offset - obj_base. The raw positions had been appended verbatim, landing the three entries at OBJ x=480-528/y=344-352 — emitted every frame, never on screen, invisible to every RAM-basis gate.
